module: Flowgraph node "Set UI Timer" (category repeat_instant, author BeamNG, duration): displays a time in the stopwatch UI app. Inputs: "value" (seconds; if not connected, clears), "color" (white/red/green/blue; empty = white), "useGenericMissionDataApp" (uses the Generic Mission Data app instead of the corner timer). Hooks used: 'raceTime' and 'ScenarioResetTimer'; or ui_apps_genericMissionData.setData.
notes: In Generic Mission Data mode, the time is formatted MM:SS (no milliseconds) with category 'cornerTimer_virtual' and order 100.
In legacy timer mode, 'time' is sent in seconds and the color as 'timeColor'.

postInit.desc: Defines the templates of the color pin (white, red, green, blue).

work.desc: Sends the time to the UI (Generic Mission Data app or 'raceTime' hook), or clears the display if 'value' is nil.
